lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The clusters are arranged in approximately five distinguishable horizontal tracks, with larger, more isolated blobs in the mid-flank and smaller, higher-density clusters near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a regular, grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance edge on the superior side and a shadow gradient on the inferior side, running parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) visible as elongated, high-luminance silhouettes positioned near the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
